title: Lamborghini’s flagship Revuelto levels up with SV trim
summary: The front-end changes alone provide a 100 percent increase in front downforce compared with the standard Revuelto, which gives the car greater stability as it enters corners and begins turning, effectively helping to “glue” the front of the car to the track.
